text: At its meeting on September 3, 2019, the Board of Health Budget Committee considered Item HU3.3, Enhancement to Toronto Public Health's 2019 Operating Budget for the Ontario Seniors Dental Care Program.

City Council on October 2 and 3, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council increase the Toronto Public Health 2019 Operating Budget by $2,111.0 thousand gross, $0 net, and 52 permanent positions to be used for pre-implementation and implementation costs associated with delivering the Ontario Seniors Dental Care Program.
